$comment: One precedence order for EVERY platform error-body parser, auth and vault alike (HPS-48). The competing-key vectors are the point: a single-key body cannot distinguish two orders, which is how auth and vault shipped opposite ones.

vectors.note: error_description beats error: prose over machine code. The 410 body that motivated the rule.
error_code beats error; the machine-readable `code` is a SEPARATE read and is unaffected by the message precedence

body.error_description: This order is no longer available

vectors.note: three competing keys at once: error_description wins over both
